description: Official-SEC corrections for the three missing-CIK identities selected by the v4 full-market proposal.

decisions.rationale: The local listing combines the predecessor ticker CPSR with the successor company name during dates when SEC filings identify the traded common-stock ticker as GLS.

evidence.observed_fact: Gelesis states that predecessor CPSR changed its name in January 2022 and its common stock began trading under GLS on January 14, 2022.

decisions.rationale: An official SEC filing identifies Oak Woods Acquisition Corp under this CIK.

evidence.observed_fact: The SEC filing detail names Oak Woods Acquisition Corp as filer CIK 0001945422.

decisions.rationale: An official SEC cover page identifies Scorpius Holdings and common-stock ticker SCPX under this CIK.

evidence.observed_fact: The filing identifies Scorpius Holdings, Inc., ticker SCPX on NYSE American, under CIK 0001476963.
